title: Japanese Style Potato Tempura
description: A crispy Japanese tempura dish made with thinly sliced potatoes, perfect as a side or snack.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/8 inch thick rounds

ingredients.name: new potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/8 inch thick rounds

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, water, and soda water to make the tempura batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Dip potato slices into the tempura batter, making sure they are fully coated.
Carefully place the battered potato slices into the hot oil. Do not overcrowd the pan.
Fry the potatoes for 3-4 minutes or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried potatoes from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Japanese style potato tempura hot and enjoy!
